title: Garden Wedding Ideas and What to Plan For
audience: 30s, couples who are interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, 150k+ AUD budget
notes: Facet page gathering our own real garden weddings plus ideas and planning advice. Title 41 chars, meta title the same. Person's choice: featured weddings are introduced by the couple's names exactly as our published story names them and link to it; venues and vendors are never named (describe the setting instead). Real wedding details only as each of our own stories states them. Styling ideas with no seasonal flower claims unless sourced. Planning points as venue questions. Destination month and Oceania pages only if live, else LINK comments. No prices, venue or vendor names, best, rankings, statistics, research talk, free (write 'a route without steps'), last dance, em dashes. Never AI images for real weddings or venues; real wedding images only if the register shows licence and consent. Never link /destinations/africa or /destinations/latin-america-caribbean.
